controls.textBefore: QUESTIONS What people ask us first. Why not just use Claude or ChatGPT? You can, and our method runs in Claude. What we add is the structure: a specialist agent for each area, a second AI checking each finding, every claim graded and sourced, and a memo your committee can read. The platform adds a workflow your team shares across a deal or a whole portfolio, and a secure vault for your evidence and memos. If the method is free, why pay for the platform? Can I use my Claude subscription? What does the AI usage cost? Who can see my documents? When should I hire you instead?
